args.description: One vertical thin pale silver blue line down the middle of a transparent canvas. Long delicate stroke, only1pixel wide. Dim and broken at its top, bright at its bottom. Very minimal pixel art. Straight vertical orientation, no diagonal slash, no dots around it, no objects.

One VERTICAL straight needle of bluegray light. Extremely narrow,2pixels wide and12pixels tall, centered in empty transparent canvas. Thin dim top tail tapers upward, lower end brighter, pale cool gray. Minimal crisp square pixels. Straight upright line, no diagonal, no object, no icon.

args.action: Small raindrop falls straight down and hits an invisible flat ground at canvas centre, breaks outward into a very LOW two-sided water splash and three tiny detached droplets. Droplets fall and dissolve. Single quick impact, no loop. Preserve pale desaturated bluegray palette, no objects or ground background, keep all pixels inside transparent margins.
